rules: Match the exact employee and live attendance status to the documented schedule.
Apply the role group's approved arrival allowance.
A corrected punch is controlling only when its correction record is approved and names an approver.
When a correction is unapproved, evaluate the original observed time.
Timestamp regularity, office location, and job category are not performance or merit evidence.
authorized_updates: Set each exact pending bonus row to approved or ineligible with its controlling evidence reference. Do not edit attendance or schedule evidence.
